event_data.MessageDetail: The Event log service was started.

events.raw_message: The Event log service was started.

security_context.significance: Sistem önyükleme zaman çizgisini belirler. Günlük kaydının başlangıcını belgeler.

events.raw_message: A service was installed in the system. Service Name: SysmonAgentService, Image Path: C:\Program Files\Sysinternals\sysmon64.exe -i -accepteula, Service Type: user mode service, Start Type: auto start, Account Name: LocalSystem.

security_context.mitre_technique: T1543.003 - Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
security_context.significance: Sistemde yeni bir servisin kurulduğunu belgeler. Zararlı yazılımların kalıcılık sağlama girişimlerini yakalamada en kritik olaydır.

events.raw_message: The process C:\Windows\System32\shutdown.exe has initiated the restart of computer SEC-CORP-WS01 on behalf of user SEC-CORP\administrator for the following reason: Operating System: Upgrade (Planned). Reason Code: 0x40003.

security_context.significance: Sistemin kim tarafından, hangi süreçle ve ne sebeple yeniden başlatıldığını adli olarak kanıtlar.
